speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help diagnose your fatigue and itching, do you have any dark urine or pale stools, and have you noticed any yellowing of your skin or eyes?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of ulcerative colitis, have you noticed any yellowing of your skin or eyes, and is your urine dark or your stools pale? I also need to know if you have had any recent fevers or right upper quadrant abdominal pain.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. I also have Scleral icterus, Multiple scratch marks on trunk and extremities.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The presence of scleral icterus confirms jaundice, and your history of ulcerative colitis raises strong suspicion for Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis. To differentiate this from other causes like autoimmune hepatitis or viral hepatitis, I need to check your specific liver enzyme patterns and autoantibodies.

REQUEST TEST: Liver_Function_Panel
REQUEST TEST: Anti-Mitochondrial_Antibody
REQUEST TEST: Anti-Nuclear_Antibody
REQUEST TEST: Hepatitis_B_and_C_Serology

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Liver_Function_Panel: Bilirubin_Total 1.5 mg/dL, Bilirubin_Direct 0.9 mg/dL, Alkaline_Phosphatase 460 U/L, AST 75 U/L, ALT 78 U/L. Anti-Mitochondrial_Antibody: Negative. Anti-Nuclear_Antibody: Negative. Hepatitis_B_and_C_Serology: NORMAL READINGS

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for confirming the absence of fever, joint pain, or travel history; this helps rule out infectious or systemic causes like reactive arthritis. Given your history of ulcerative colitis and the cholestatic picture, I need to visualize the bile ducts to confirm the diagnosis.

REQUEST TEST: MRCP
REQUEST IMAGES

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: MRCP: Thickening of the bile ducts and focal bile duct dilatation.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The MRCP findings of bile duct thickening and dilatation, combined with your history of ulcerative colitis and cholestatic symptoms, are classic for Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis. I have sufficient evidence to confirm the diagnosis.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis
